name: P29 - Patrol Boat
description: Former patrol boat of the Armed Forces of Malta (built as the East German Boltenhagen), 52 m long, scuttled off Ċirkewwa in 2007 after being cleaned for divers. Sits upright at 34 m with its highest point at 12 m, about 150 m out and close to the tug Rozi. Openings were left for experienced divers to go inside.
conditions: In summer a yellow buoy usually marks the wreck.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites.
